caption: The drawing features a brown and white bull with curly fur, shown in profile facing to the right. The bull has a light brown body with darker brown shading, white legs and underbelly, and a white face. Its horns are yellow with brown tips, and the nose is pinkish-red. The tail is brown, narrowing into a tuft with purple and brown coloring. The bull appears to be suspended in the air by green cords attached to three points on its body: the tail, the back, and the head. These cords converge upwards and are tied to a single horizontal brown stick above the bull. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or scenery present. The artist’s signature, "HILDA OLSON," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Puppet: Bull
